description: Upload a locally executed run (generation/replay) to cloud workflow records.

actionScript.description: Generated action script steps from local execution

displayParams.description: Window size the run executed at, copied from the run's actionParams

errorMessage.description: Error message when status is failed

freshSession.description: True when the run started from an emptied browser session, copied from the run's actionParams. Omit otherwise

electronAppVersion.description: Electron app version used for local run

localExecutionCompletedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when local run completed

mcpServerVersion.description: MCP server version used for local run

originalUrl.description: Original local URL used during local execution (typically localhost)

productionUrl.description: Cloud production URL for the test case

runByUserId.description: User ID who executed the run locally

uploadedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when uploaded to cloud

pinnedAccount.description: The pinned account the run signed in as, copied from the run's actionParams. Omit when the run was not pinned

emailSecretId.description: Secret ID (UUID) of the secret holding the account email

passwordSecretId.description: Secret ID (UUID) of the secret holding the account password

productionUrl.description: Cloud production URL associated with the run

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) for the local run

runEnvironmentType.description: Environment lane for the run: 'local' (developer localhost) or 'remote' (deployed). Selects which versioned runSettings/credentials lane the cloud resolves. Omit for remote (default).

runSettingsId.description: runSettings record the run executed under, copied from the run's actionParams. Omit when it named none

runType.description: Type of local run to upload

testCaseId.description: Test case ID (UUID) for the local run

useCaseId.description: Use case ID (UUID) for the local run

name: muggle-remote-local-run-upload
